ticket.title: Starting a visit from a patient search result throws because the patient-chart workspace group is launched without group props
ticket.text:
Starting a visit from a patient search result throws because the patient-chart workspace group is launched without group props

## Symptom

Starting a visit from a patient search result card (the legacy `start-visit-button-slot` — e.g. the ward "Add patient to ward" flow, and any patient-banner Start visit button rendered outside the chart) throws:

`can't access property "patientUuid", e.groupProps is null`

Reproduces on dev3. Surfaced during review of openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-management#2172 (that PR is unrelated and correct; this is a pre-existing legacy-path bug).

## Root cause

`start-visit-workspace-form` belongs to the `patient-chart` workspace group. Launched from inside the chart, the group is already open with group props (patient, patientUuid, visitContext). Launched cold from patient search, `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/start-visit-button.component.tsx` calls `launchWorkspace2` with `patientUuid` in `workspaceProps` and omits the 4th `groupProps` argument, so the group opens with `groupProps = null`.

The framework then renders the group's action menu, passing `groupProps = null` to every patient-chart action-button icon, and `VisitForm` reads its patient context only from `groupProps`. Both destructure it unguarded and throw. The notes visit-note button is the one that surfaces because it is registered with `getSyncLifecycle` (renders synchronously) while the orders/forms buttons are async, but the fragility is shared.

Dates to the Workspace v2 migration (O3-4961).

## Fix (two small bug-fix PRs, patient-management merged/released first)

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-management` — pass the mapped FHIR `patient` into the legacy `start-visit-button-slot` state (parity with `start-visit-button-slot2`, which already does), in `patient-banner.component.tsx`. Add a test asserting the legacy slot receives `patientUuid` and `patient`.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart` — in `start-visit-button.component.tsx`, accept `patient` and launch with the patient-chart group props as the 4th `launchWorkspace2` argument (`{ patient, patientUuid, visitContext: null, mutateVisitContext: null }`); drop `patientUuid` from `workspaceProps` (VisitForm reads it from `groupProps`). Update the test to assert the four-argument call.

Kept separate from #2172.

understanding.intent: Allow users to start a visit from patient search results or banners outside the patient chart without encountering an error.

criteria.text: Clicking the Start Visit button from a patient search result card or external patient banner (such as the 'Add patient to ward' flow) successfully opens the start visit workspace form without throwing an error.

understanding.reason: Testers can navigate to search results or ward flows outside the patient chart, click the Start Visit button, and verify that the start visit form opens correctly without UI crashes.
